findings.note: Registry content, validation, and registry_digest are not bound to one retained snapshot. The resolver reads registry_document, then separately validates the live path and invokes generate-registry-digest --whole, which independently rediscovers/rereads the Registry. A Registry change between these operations can make evaluations use generation A while validation and context_binding.registry_digest describe generation B; the later recheck compares against B and therefore cannot detect the mixed generation. This violates REQ-001/REQ-002's fixed-snapshot and snapshot-generation-mismatch guarantees.

The advisory/required byte-identity requirement is not satisfied. Changing workflow.capability_enforcement changes the canonical Project Context, so source_sha256/full_context_revision, the Context Projection workflow and projection_sha256 all change, in addition to Resolver Evidence.state. The implementation preserves those differences, contrary to AC-016's claim that only Evidence.state differs; the requirement or implementation/test oracle must be reconciled.

The required regression check is marked passes=true although the latest full PowerShell run explicitly did not complete and the evidence recommends rerunning it before sign-off. For a feature requiring sh/ps1 parity, an incomplete required regression run cannot support a passing verification claim.
